honest_prior: LOW-EV. SP cap-w capital gate CONFIRMED FAIL (R31 paired 1.523<2.0). This round is NOT a capital retry. Goal = (a) EW-basis deployability D3-form dossier material, (b) OVERLAY_CANDIDATE feature qualification, (c) 2024+ survival robustness diagnosis. Material preservation value because SP is the sole 2024+ surviving value axis (R31 post24 1.85, dIR_post +0.104, EW-uni 6.60, EW-oos 0.61, placebo p 0.025, lag1 2.147).
base_authority: clean recon_panels (WT_D20260714_004, production_parity_verified, off0 T-1) READ-ONLY. §7b.
metric_type_primary: canonical_screen (EW top-25 long-only, 15bps, liq 2e8) + canonical_screen_diag (EW-universe basis)
SP_definition: V20_SP single factor, aligned-z (C13), per-month cross-sectional z within base membership. Reuse stage_artifacts/WT_D20260714_007/subaxis_panels.parquet$SP.

part1_ew_basis_deployability.sp_ew_track: canonical_screen_bt(SP score, top_n=25, liq 2e8, 15bps, size_dt=SIZE, diag_dual_basis=TRUE). Report cap-w bench PORT_t + diag_ew_universe PORT_t/post2017_t/oos_retention_approx + net_sr + turnover.
part1_ew_basis_deployability.oos_retention_v2: anchored 3-split {55/65/75} median on EW-active. Band [0.5,0.7) -> 2/3 supporting evidence check (trailing-subwindow PORT_t>0, placebo p<0.05, book-marginal). PASS if >=0.7 / FAIL if <0.5.
part1_ew_basis_deployability.capacity: min holding ADV x weight -> max AUM at 5% ADV participation cap.
part1_ew_basis_deployability.active_corr_vs_papertrack: SP EW-active vs P-pure base (act_ew) and D-2 (act_ew) sealed series, monthly. Also holding overlap Jaccard.
part1_ew_basis_deployability.predicted: SP EW-basis PORT_t strong (~6, R31 diag), oos band [0.5,0.7). Deployability material IF corr vs incumbent paper-tracks < ~0.5 (adds diversification) — else redundant.

part2_overlay_feature.sp_ew_tilt_overlay: 0.7*base_z + 0.3*SP_z EW top-25 vs base EW. paired NW-t lag3 marginal (m1-drain FQ-017 format).
part2_overlay_feature.sp_incumbent_overlay: 0.7*bk_score_eff_z + 0.3*SP_z EW top-25 vs bk EW. paired marginal.
part2_overlay_feature.predicted: marginal likely small at EW (SP orthogonal but signal weak full-period). Qualify as OVERLAY_CANDIDATE feature if marginal paired-t > 0 and PIT-safe.

part3_2024plus_robustness.rolling: rolling 24m PORT_t of SP EW-active — spike vs sustained.
part3_2024plus_robustness.sector_concentration: SP top-25 EW holdings sector distribution (RAWDATA Sector) pre vs post-2024 — is post24 edge sector-concentrated (single-regime) or broad (structural)?
part3_2024plus_robustness.predicted: post24 edge partly sector-concentrated (value-cyclicals). Honest: single 2.5yr window is thin — label single-regime risk.

gates.note: screening-tier only, NOT dossier. No forge/judge. No capital gate declared. book_state/05_Production/outputs/ramp UNCHANGED. stage_artifacts only. DART API forbidden (factor_db only). No covariance/weights (alpha-research role boundary).
gates.selection_type: chain (single factor SP characterization, not sweep — DSR gate not applicable, diagnostic only)

challenge_concerns_preregistered: C1: SP 2024+ survival may be mean-reversion tailwind (post-decline bounce) not structural sales-yield premium — pre/post + rolling must distinguish.
C2: EW-basis is not investable (no EW benchmark mandate; deployment universe is cap-w KOSPI200) — EW-basis strength is diagnostic of signal, not a deployable book.
C3: sales-yield low-quality trap — high sales / negative earnings firms (distressed) may dominate SP top-decile; edge may be junk-rally not value.
C4: 2.5yr post-2024 window (~30 months) is thin for a regime claim — SE wide.
C5: active corr vs P-pure paper-tracks may be high (both cap-tier-localized small-cap value tilts) -> redundant consumption.
